layoutDatum.name: R3 robot datum: carpet plane at the frame centre, +X toward the intake, +Y left, millimetres

cases.basis: Unfold the intake from its legal starting fold through 135 degrees to the floor pickup pose
Drive onto the FUEL; it reaches the ramp toe 3 mm clear of the carpet plane
The roller drives the FUEL up the 45 degree ramp with 3 mm undeformed reserve to ramp and roller
First chord over the ramp's rear edge at 82 mm centre radius
Second chord to the crest above the ramp's rear edge
Carry the FUEL over the bumper, front rail and lip into the hopper
Release onto the floor belts at the front of the indexer lane
Drive loaded from the DEPOT side of the alliance zone to the shot pose (robot frame: the field moves)
A floor-belt cleat carries the tracked FUEL 290 mm aft to the flywheel pinch
The FUEL rolls 60 degrees around the flywheel against the hood and releases at 60 degrees elevation
Ballistic arc 1 of 4 at 6.91 m/s toward the HUB opening (prescribed; drag Cd 0.47; circular fit within 2.5 mm)
Ballistic arc 2 of 4 at 6.91 m/s toward the HUB opening (prescribed; drag Cd 0.47; circular fit within 2.5 mm)
Ballistic arc 3 of 4 at 6.91 m/s toward the HUB opening (prescribed; drag Cd 0.47; circular fit within 2.5 mm)
Ballistic arc 4 of 4 at 6.91 m/s toward the HUB opening (prescribed; drag Cd 0.47; circular fit within 2.5 mm)
Drive sideways to the TOWER line and reset the indexer cleat
Close to 5 mm from the uprights with the deployed intake between them
Swing both hooks 180 degrees inboard above the rung so the jaws pass beyond it
Lower the hooks onto the low rung; a 2 mm seat contact is required at the end of the stroke

requiredContacts.id: left hook seats on low rung
requiredContacts.criterion: Hook arm underside within 2 mm of the rung top

requiredContacts.id: right hook seats on low rung
requiredContacts.criterion: Hook arm underside within 2 mm of the rung top

cases.basis: Retract the hooks 70 mm; in the robot frame the field and hooks move down together (Level 1 clears carpet and base)
After the match, lower the robot back to the carpet
Lift the battery straight out through the open hopper with the intake deployed and hooks stowed; the 2 m stroke passes the field fixtures' envelope used by the checker
Lift the flywheel, hood, side plates and motor out as one module
